## Crawling

---


[Entity Condition Type](https://apugli.readthedocs.io/en/latest/types/entity_condition_types).

Checks whether the entity is currently crawling.

Type ID: `apugli:crawling`

---

### Example
```json
{
    "entity_condition": {
        "type": "apugli:crawling"
    }
}
```
